beats.summary: Michael struggles with deciding how to allocate a budget surplus without disappointing anyone.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I hate disappointing just one person. And I really hate disappointing everyone.

beats.summary: Michael reveals that branch managers get 15% of savings as a bonus and considers keeping $645 for himself.

evidence.snippet: David: Branch managers who come in under budget get 15% of the savings.

beats.summary: Michael debates between returning the surplus for office needs or keeping the bonus for himself.

evidence.snippet: Pam: You're gonna give yourself a bonus of $645 instead of getting the entire office something it really needs?
Michael: I don't need $645; I already have $645, more or less.

beats.summary: Michael delegates the decision to the office, telling them to decide or he will take the bonus.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, you know what? Why don't you guys deal with it? I am going to get up, and I am going to be out in the common area.

beats.summary: Pam and Oscar decide to go with new chairs instead of nothing.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Hey, we're going with the chairs.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on lessons learned and shows a fur coat covered in fake blood.

evidence.snippet: camera zooms out to see fake blood is splattered on the fur coat
